title: Done today: repeating tasks log their completions
steps: Open Chores and tick Water the plants. For a moment it shows ticked and struck through; then it moves on to its next date on the same line, its new due date standing out, with `last:` and today's date written in. A notice at the bottom says "Done · next due Thu, Oct 8 · Logged in today's note", with Undo and Open log; Open log jumps to its line under ## Done in Journal/<today>, made with just the date as its title if it wasn't there.
Its chip now reads "✓ Today · 1×": when it was last done, and how many completions the daily notes log for it. Click it for the list, each opening its daily note at its line.

With reduced motion (your system's setting), the tick moves the task on at once: no pause, just the highlight and the notice. With Tasks › Completion log set to none, the notice doesn't say it was logged.
Back in Chores, undo (u in Vim, ⌘Z otherwise): the tick and its log line go together. Redo brings both back.
Tick Book a dentist appointment: a plain task is ticked with done: in Chores, and not logged. Set Tasks › Log plain tasks in settings (⌘,) to log those too.

⌘⇧P, Show tasks: Today has a Done today group, with what's logged today and the plain tasks ticked today. Untick Water the plants there: it asks whether to put it back in Chores (due again the day you ticked it) or only take it out of the log.
In today's note, untick a line under ## Done: the same question.

Settings: Tasks › Completion log is daily (the default), inline (v1's ticked copy, with the next one below it) or none (history only). Daily notes › Folder moves the daily notes (Journal by default). Open the previous or next day's note from ⌘⇧P.
History shows the tick in Chores as Completed 'Water the plants' (due …) and the log line in today's note as Logged 'Water the plants' as done (Chores), both by you.
Agents tick tasks with the complete_task tool, which moves a repeating task on and logs it the same way.
